subject: Your team's real numbers vs. what they should be
previewText: Performance benchmarks that separate top producers from everyone else

featuredArticle.title: Benchmarking Your Aged Lead Team: Performance Standards by Role and Experience Level
featuredArticle.spotlight: Most sales managers don't know if their team is underperforming because they don't know what good looks like. This framework gives you role-specific benchmarks for contact rates, close rates, and KPIs that separate top producers from the rest.
